input.quote: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman.
input.rationale: Section 17(b) gives us an unconditional convenience termination right at any time on 90 days' written notice, with no early-termination fee, penalty or other exit charge anywhere in the Agreement (no non-refundability or termination-fee language appears in the fee provisions). Garman has no convenience right: its only termination triggers are the insolvency events and uncured material default in Section 17(c), and the maintenance term in Section 10 simply runs as a renewable one-year term. The 90-day notice period sits at the fallback rather than our preferred 30 days, and the Agreement is silent on a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees on a 17(b) termination (Section 17(c) provides a return of fees for services not rendered only on termination for Garman's default) — both are minor sub-elements short of the preferred position and not worth a redline given the otherwise clean, penalty-free exit and the perpetual (non-committed-term) licence structure.
